important_definition_difference.thigh: Queued pilot rotates femur local -Y. Knee translation splines mean that vector must not be described as an exact hip-to-knee joint-center line without an explicit comparison. Both definitions can be valid derived quantities, but they are different.
important_definition_difference.shank: Queued pilot rotates tibia local -Y. Its source frame and ankle offset are explicitly recorded; do not substitute it for a marker-defined segment axis without deciding the definition.
important_definition_difference.foot: Queued pilot rotates calcaneus local +X. Placed heel/metatarsal marker offsets include nonzero vertical/lateral differences; local +X is not identical to the actual model landmark direction. The calcaneus body includes hindfoot/midfoot/metatarsals, while toes remain a separate body.
important_definition_difference.heading: Queued pilot uses pelvis +X projected horizontally per sample. This is pelvis-relative heading, not independently validated direction of travel or treadmill belt direction. Keep the chosen frame explicit.
important_definition_difference.neutral: No neutral calibration is applied in the queued pilot. Model coordinate zero and physical foot-flat/clinical neutral are not interchangeable.

canonical_specification_comparison.disposition: No user preference is required to preserve explicitly named derived model-axis projections with exact body axes, pelvis-relative heading and zero reference. These source-derived quantities must remain separate from unsupported canonical anatomical fields. Canonical restoration requires an evidence-backed shared anatomical/frame definition and independently verified mapping; the present specification does not supply that mapping.
